metadata.source_package_note: Packet 007 in the pass-one dispatch is authoritative for Family 7. The standalone F7.md was not used because it is an Alternative R&B proxy under the dispatch map, not Family 7 Hip-Hop.

normalization.source_seed_policy: Artists named in Packet 007 are marked existing_seed=true when instantiated; album and song rows are marked existing_seed=false because Packet 007 names no specific album or song titles.
normalization.version_policy: Explicit/clean edits, remixes, cover versions, soundtrack contexts, and feature-credit variants are flagged in consolidation warnings rather than collapsed.
